summary: Hubleys is a personal dashboard tool designed to help multiple users organise and access their links from a single interface. Configuration is managed centrally via a YAML file, allowing administrators to define the layout and available resources. It is distributed under the MIT licence and packaged as a Docker container.
goodFor: It suits small teams or households that want a self-hosted, text-file-driven start page to share common bookmarks and links.
watchOut: Editing a central YAML file for configuration lacks a graphical user interface, which may make day-to-day management less convenient for non-technical users.
deployNotes: Because it runs in Docker, you will typically need to mount a persistent volume for your configuration files and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
